expressions.text: // Rock shake with multiple impacts (Position + shared array)amps = [6,12,20];   // amplitude in pixelsfreq = 8;  // shakes per seconddecays = [1,4,10];  // how quickly it settles// Times of hammer hits (seconds)impacts = [0.5, 1.5, 2.5];offset = [0,0];for (i = 0; i < impacts.length; i++){  t = time - impacts[i];  if (t >= 0){	  amp=amps[1];	  decay=decays[1];    offset += [Math.sin(freq*t*2*Math.PI)/Math.exp(decay*t)*amp,               Math.cos(freq*t*2*Math.PI)/Math.exp(decay*t)*amp];  }}value + offset

// Rock shake with multiple impacts (Rotation + shared array)amps = [.25,.5,.75];    // amplitude in degreesfreq = 10;decay = 3;// Same impact times as Positionimpacts = [0.5, 1.5, 2.5];rot = 0;for (i = 0; i < impacts.length; i++){  t = time - impacts[i];  if (t >= 0){	  amp=amps[i];    rot += Math.sin(freq*t*2*Math.PI)/Math.exp(decay*t)*amp;  }}value + rot
